pageTitle: Calculate Your University of Miami GPA

officialLinks.label: Undergraduate grades, GPA formula, symbols and standing

helpIntro: University of Miami uses a 4.0 quality-point scale. Enter UM credit hours and final grades to estimate your current/cumulative GPA, projected GPA, and target GPA.
helpNote: This profile estimates the standard undergraduate UM institutional GPA. Transfer grades are excluded from that GPA, and graduation honors use a separate lower-of UM versus combined GPA rule. Use Repeat Impact only for an eligible, elected Undergraduate Repeat Rule case.
helpExample: A 3-credit A earns 12.0 quality points and a 3-credit B+ earns 9.9. Together, 21.9 / 6 = 3.650.

gradeExplanations.A+: A+ carries the same 4.00 quality points per credit as A.
gradeExplanations.A: A = 4.00 quality points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.A-: A- = 3.70 quality points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.B+: B+ = 3.30 quality points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.B: B = 3.00 quality points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.B-: B- = 2.70 quality points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.C+: C+ = 2.30 quality points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.C: C = 2.00 quality points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.C-: C- = 1.70 quality points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.D+: D+ = 1.30 quality points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.D: D = 1.00 quality points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.F: F carries 0 quality points and its attempted credits count in GPA.
gradeExplanations.XF: Academic-integrity failure; 0 points and not eligible for the Undergraduate Repeat Rule.
gradeExplanations.IE: Incomplete notation that counts as attempted credit with 0 quality points.
gradeExplanations.IF: Incomplete failure notation; attempted credits count with 0 quality points.
gradeExplanations.E: Historical failing grade used prior to Fall 1995; 0 points.
gradeExplanations.CR: Credit earned; excluded from GPA attempted hours and quality points.
gradeExplanations.NC: No Credit; excluded from GPA attempted hours and quality points.
gradeExplanations.I: Incomplete; excluded until replaced by a final grade.
gradeExplanations.IP: In Progress; excluded from GPA while unresolved.
gradeExplanations.W: Withdrawal; excluded from GPA attempted hours and quality points.
gradeExplanations.NG: No grade reported; excluded until resolved.

specialTypes.name: UM course, standard grading
specialTypes.note: Use for ordinary undergraduate University of Miami courses with final grades.

specialTypes.name: External transfer credit
specialTypes.note: Accepted transfer credit does not enter the UM cumulative GPA. Graduation honors use a separate combined-GPA test.

specialTypes.name: Test, military, or other non-quality-point credit
specialTypes.note: Credit may be awarded, but these categories do not carry UM quality points for the institutional GPA.

repeatPolicy.note: Use Repeat Impact only when you qualify for and elect the Undergraduate Repeat Rule. It estimates replacement of an eligible D/D+/F with the second final grade; confirm timing, course identity, school rules, and filing requirements with your advisor.
